text.7:25: He said: There shall ye live, and there shall ye die, and thence shall ye be brought forth.
text.8:42: When ye were on the near bank (of the valley) and they were on the yonder bank, and the caravan was below you (on the coast plain). And had ye trysted to meet one another ye surely would have failed to keep the tryst, but (it happened, as it did, without the forethought of either of you) that Allah might conclude a thing that must be done; that he who perished (on that day) might perish by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty) and he who survived might survive by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty). Lo! Allah in truth is Hearer, Knower.
text.20:74: Lo! whoso cometh guilty unto his Lord, verily for him is hell. There he will neither die nor live.
text.23:37: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).
text.45:24: And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess.
text.87:13: Wherein he will neither die nor live.
